name: emst-explorer
description: EMST Tier 1 static, local-first explorer (WP-12). Generated from an EMST release build; no server, no accounts, no cookies, no analytics, no runtime third-party requests.

scripts.build: node tools/prepare-release.mjs && node tools/vendor.mjs && node tools/sbom.mjs && node tools/clean.mjs && npx @11ty/eleventy --quiet && node tools/check-output.mjs
scripts.test: node tools/test-checks.mjs && node tools/check-output.mjs && node tools/browser-checks.mjs
